policies.text: A maritime carrier obtains Coastal Vessel Operating Clearance provided it maintains a maritime passenger transport permit.
A transit enterprise is assigned to Priority Corridor Service provided that vendor qualifies for Tier-One Transit Vendor recognition.
A charter enterprise achieves premier dispatch certification when demonstrating a punctuality rate of at least 95%.
A transport business receives Green Fleet Endorsement if its fleet electrification percentage reaches at least 80%.
An air freight firm qualifies for Rapid Customs Pre-check provided its manifest accuracy rate is at least 99%.
A carrier achieves Tier-A Cargo Protection clearance provided its insurance coverage is 5000000 USD or more.

A transport company qualifies for Tier-One Transit Vendor recognition either by maintaining a safety rating of at least 90 points along with a training rate of 100%, or through holding an ISO 39001 road traffic safety certification.
